title: Pushout joins with a weak equivalence are right anodyne
statement:
Use small simplicial sets, standard simplices and weak homotopy equivalences of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], and right anodyne maps of [def-coef-infinity-right-anodyne]. For simplicial sets $X,Y$ define their ordered join by $(X\star Y)_n=X_n\amalg Y_n\amalg\coprod_{a+b+1=n}X_a\times Y_b$, with $a,b\geq0$; simplicial operators restrict the initial block of $X$-vertices and final block of $Y$-vertices, with empty blocks giving the pure-factor summands. Let $i:A_0\hookrightarrow A$ and $j:B_0\hookrightarrow B$ be degreewise injective inclusions of small simplicial sets, and assume that $j$ is a weak homotopy equivalence. Then the canonical inclusion
$$
(A_0\star B)\amalg_{A_0\star B_0}(A\star B_0)\hookrightarrow A\star B
$$
is right anodyne. The displayed domain is the degreewise union of the two indicated simplicial subsets of $A\star B$, whose intersection is $A_0\star B_0$; equivalently it is their simplicial pushout. No Kan or quasicategory hypothesis is imposed on the four simplicial sets.

source.place: HTT Lemma 4.2.3.5 (Joyal), printed p. 251, PDF page 269. No Stacks tag: this is a simplicial right-anodyne join lemma.
